name: Time Frame 9
definition: Time frame elements that define a period as number of days before or after a activity.

TradeMinus.name: Trade Minus
TradeMinus.definition: Number of days before the trade date (T) used for the standard timeframe for the dealing cut-off.

NonWorkingDayAdjustment.name: Non Working Day Adjustment
NonWorkingDayAdjustment.definition: Convention used for adjusting a date when it is not a business day.

ReferToOrderDesk.name: Refer To Order Desk
ReferToOrderDesk.definition: For the dealing cut-off time, the order desk must be contacted.

TradeMinusRule.definition: If TradeMinus is present then NonWorkingDayAdjustment must also be present.

NonWorkingDayAdjustmentRule.definition: If NonWorkingDayAdjustment is present then TradeMinus must also be present.
